instruction: Pick a palette by feel (read description, vibes, notes), then APPLY it. On a scene: pass its id as `paletteId` to getlayers_materialize — the tint map is built from its roles and you drop it into the scene CONFIG, never the shader. On a section/DOM: map roles → the --gl-* colour tokens (background→od-bg, primary→od-ink, secondary→od-bg-alt/surface, accent→od-accent), use `ink` for legible text, and `swatch` for any gradient. A palette is one hue set for the WHOLE thing — do not mix two on one surface.

palettes.name: AI Studio palette
palettes.description: The colour ramp lifted from the AI Studio style — dark ground with a #9a73f0 accent. Portable: apply it to any scene or section without adopting AI Studio's type or tokens.
palettes.notes: Extracted from ai-studio-style. The accent (#9a73f0) is the one hue that carries the brand — ration it. Roles map 1:1 onto a scene's paletteRoles for tinting.
